snippet.title: Sloptoberfest Early Access Trailer - Oktober 2026 On Steam
snippet.description:
Your Own Beer Tent. Your Rules. Your Chaos.

Uncle Sepp didn’t leave you much. A small beer tent, a few tables, an old beer tap, and a mountain of debt. But hey, at least it’s a business. What happens next is up to you. In Sloptoberfest, you and your friends take over the tent and try to turn the little shack into a thriving business. Pour beer, serve food, keep your guests happy, and hopefully end the day with more money in the register than you started with.

The better your business does, the bigger you can get. Expand your tent, buy new equipment, build a proper bathroom, decorate the place, and hire staff when the work gets too much. Or just do everything yourselves. Eventually, you can even build your own little brewery and brew your very own beer.

Play solo or team up with up to three friends. Divide the work, organize yourselves, and try to keep the place running – or just let the chaos unfold. While you're taking care of your guests, there’s plenty more to do around the festival grounds. Play carnival games, earn some extra cash, and invest your profits back into your tent.

And then there’s Huber. His tent may be smaller than yours, but he has it out for you. While you're trying to keep your business running, Huber can sabotage your daily operations and make your life miserable. Luckily, you don’t have to take it lying down. A little sabotage of your own can make sure Huber gets a taste of his own medicine. Because at the festival, it’s not always about who has the better tent – sometimes it’s about who can annoy the other guy the most.

Beer. Friends. Chaos. And a beer tent that’s all yours. Turn it into something great – as long as Huber doesn’t ruin everything first.
